# Design

Use this page when you build or review a screen. The product wins over the craft floor and the refuse list.

What this page says the product is, how its design system is laid out and what it does on purpose
overrides any general rule of craft: a rule of the craft floor or of the refuse list that this page
sets aside is set aside here. A repository whose design system is already written down points this
form, or one section of it, at that page with a `See:` line.

## Product
<!-- slot: product · required · by: invade -->
- **Who and where.** The harbourmaster and two seasonal staff, at a desk in the dock office by the
  window, on a laptop; visiting skippers on a phone on the pontoon, often in full sun and with wet
  hands, or at dusk (`README.md`).
- **Voice.** Plain and exact, like a shipping forecast: a berth code, a day, a 24-hour time
  ("Berth B12 is yours from Fri 14:00 to Sun 11:00."). Never "seamless", never "experience"
  (`README.md` › Voice).
- **Admires.** The Met Office shipping forecast: dense, plain, read the same way by everyone
  (`README.md`).
